certification.rationale: Highest-ranked available source is tier 2 (Non-financial annual or regulatory report), as of 2024-12-31, reporting 513. 0 independent corroborating source(s) within 15%. Confidence 3 (Supported).

notes: Form 990 filings found on ProPublica (EIN 943062436).

No SEC filings exist; tier 2 Form 990 line 5 figures (513 for 2024, 518 for 2023, 475 for 2022) are the anchor and were supplied separately. Line 5 counts all W-2 recipients during the year, so it can run above point-in-time headcount; third-party estimates (373-458) and Revelio's 438 sit below it. LinkedIn member count is from a cached snippet of unknown date (a /life page snippet showed 331); the company's own LinkedIn description has no headcount text and no growth figures were seen. Website tiles (13 million people served, 100,000 people, 15 founding-era employees) are not current headcounts and were excluded. No mergers, acquisitions or spinoffs confirmed.
